name: What is the process for professional floor drain cleaning?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for professional floor drain cleaning?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional floor drain cleaning typically begins with an inspection, often using a camera, to identify the type and location of the clog. For minor blockages, plumbers may use augers or drain snakes to physically remove obstructions. For more stubborn clogs, hydro-jetting, which uses high-pressure water to scour the pipes clean, is often employed. The process concludes with a final check to ensure proper flow. Customers should note if their drain line connects to a main sewer line, as blockages can sometimes originate further down the system, influencing the tools and duration needed.
